newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore weekly residues down, distillates mixed.

text.p: Singapore weekly residue stocks fell by 208,000 barrels in the week ended October 16 to 10.928 million barrels, Singapore's Trade Development Board (TDB) said.
They include HSFO, LSFO, LSWR and the straight-run atmospheric residue, but exclude bitumen.
Middle-distillate stocks rose by 245,000 barrels to 8.703 million barrels.
Middle distillates comprise jet, kerosene and gas oil.
Light distillate stocks fell by 544,000 barrels to 5.407 million barrels. They comprise gasoline, reformate and naphtha. -- Singapore newsroom (65-870-3082)
